targets.rawSql: SELECT outdoor_temp_f AS "Outdoor temperature" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT feels_like_f AS "Feels like" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT wind_direction_deg AS "Wind direction", wind_speed_mph AS "Wind speed" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT wind_gust_mph AS "Wind gust" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT solar_w_m2 AS "Solar irradiance" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT uv_index AS "UV index" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT relative_pressure_inhg AS "Relative pressure" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT dewpoint_f AS "Dew point" FROM weather_observation ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT daily_rain_in AS "Today" FROM rain_observation WHERE source = 'wh40' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT weekly_rain_in AS "This week" FROM rain_observation WHERE source = 'wh40' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT monthly_rain_in AS "This month" FROM rain_observation WHERE source = 'wh40' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT yearly_rain_in AS "This year" FROM rain_observation WHERE source = 'wh40' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE
params AS (
  SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS today
),
today_rain AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(r.daily_rain_in), 0) > 0 AS wet
  FROM rain_observation r
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE r.source = 'wh40'
    AND r.observed_at >= p.today::timestamptz
    AND r.observed_at < (p.today + 1)::timestamptz
),
days AS (
  SELECT s.observation_date, COALESCE(s.rainfall_in, 0) > 0 AS wet
  FROM daily_weather_summary s
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE s.observation_date < p.today

  UNION ALL

  SELECT p.today, TRUE
  FROM params p
  CROSS JOIN today_rain t
  WHERE t.wet
),
anchor AS (
  SELECT d.observation_date, d.wet
  FROM days d
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN today_rain t
  WHERE d.observation_date = CASE WHEN t.wet THEN p.today ELSE p.today - 1 END
),
streak AS (
  SELECT a.observation_date, a.wet, 1 AS days
  FROM anchor a

  UNION ALL

  SELECT d.observation_date, d.wet, s.days + 1
  FROM streak s
  JOIN days d
    ON d.observation_date = s.observation_date - 1
   AND d.wet = s.wet
)
SELECT
  (CASE WHEN a.wet THEN 'Rain streak: ' ELSE 'Dry streak: ' END)
  || MAX(s.days)
  || CASE WHEN MAX(s.days) = 1 THEN ' day' ELSE ' days' END AS "Current streak"
FROM streak s
CROSS JOIN anchor a
GROUP BY a.wet

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE((
    SELECT CASE WHEN observed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN condition ELSE 'Unavailable' END
    FROM sky_condition_observation
    ORDER BY observed_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), 'Unavailable') AS "Sky condition",
  COALESCE((
    SELECT CASE WHEN observed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN COALESCE(rain_rate_in_hr, 0) ELSE 0 END
    FROM rain_observation
    WHERE source = 'wh40'
    ORDER BY observed_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS "Rain rate",
  COALESCE((
    SELECT CASE WHEN observed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN COALESCE(wind_speed_mph, 0) ELSE 0 END
    FROM weather_observation
    ORDER BY observed_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS "Wind speed",
  COALESCE((
    SELECT CASE WHEN observed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN wind_direction_deg ELSE NULL END
    FROM weather_observation
    ORDER BY observed_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS "Wind direction"

SELECT observed_at AS "time", outdoor_temp_f AS "Outdoor temperature", feels_like_f AS "Feels like", dewpoint_f AS "Dew point" FROM weather_observation WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at
SELECT observed_at AS "time", wind_speed_mph AS "Wind speed", wind_gust_mph AS "Wind gust" FROM weather_observation WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at
SELECT observed_at AS "time", wind_direction_deg AS "Wind direction" FROM weather_observation WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at
SELECT observed_at AS "time", solar_w_m2 AS "Solar irradiance" FROM weather_observation WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at
SELECT observed_at AS "time", rain_rate_in_hr AS "Rainfall rate", event_rain_in AS "Total rainfall" FROM rain_observation WHERE source = 'wh40' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT observed_at AS "time", absolute_pressure_inhg AS "Absolute pressure", relative_pressure_inhg AS "Relative pressure" FROM weather_observation WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT current.observed_at AS "time", current.relative_pressure_inhg - (SELECT previous.relative_pressure_inhg FROM weather_observation previous WHERE previous.observed_at <= current.observed_at - INTERVAL '3 hours' AND previous.relative_pressure_inhg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY previous.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS "3-hour pressure change" FROM weather_observation current WHERE $__timeFilter(current.observed_at) AND current.relative_pressure_inhg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY current.observed_at
